Kerala CM, Daughter Named in Vigilance Cases

Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has been named the first accused in one case, while his daughter Veena is accused in two cases related to the CMRL-Exalogic dealings. The Kerala Vigilance Department has filed two First Information Reports (FIRs) in connection with these cases.
